cases.rationale: Even if the asserted training, ten years of relevant experience and age would produce a strong points score, the route separately requires intended qualifying employment with the applicable remuneration. The stated absence of a binding Austrian job offer is therefore a current route failure on the benchmark facts. Positive training/experience assertions remain unverified scenario inputs.
cases.fact_evidence_boundary: Facts are asserted scenario inputs, not authenticated documents. The explicit absence of a binding Austrian job offer is treated as a known route failure for this benchmark; positive training/experience assertions do not establish documentary sufficiency or AMS confirmation.

cases.rationale: On the asserted benchmark facts, completed shortage-occupation training contributes 30 points, ten years of qualification-matching experience reaches the 20-point cap, and age 29 contributes 15, for 65 points. A binding Austrian job offer and applicable minimum remuneration are also asserted. The mandatory route criteria are therefore satisfied on the stated facts and the route-level label is ELIGIBLE. This does not authenticate documents, bind AMS or the residence authority, authorize submission, or imply final issuance; those downstream verification and governance steps remain separate from the route-level eligibility label.
cases.fact_evidence_boundary: All positive facts are asserted for route-evaluation testing only. ELIGIBLE means the mandatory shortage-occupation route criteria are satisfied if these facts are accepted as true; it does not mean qualification, work-experience, job-offer, remuneration, identity, or other application documents have been authenticated or accepted by AMS or the residence authority. missing_evidence=[] means no bounded route-evidence category is absent from the asserted fact set, not that the real application file is complete.

cases.rationale: On the asserted benchmark facts, training contributes 30 points while age 51, zero qualifying experience and zero language points add nothing, leaving the case below the statutory 55-point minimum. This route-level arithmetic does not itself authenticate the training documentation.
cases.fact_evidence_boundary: Facts are asserted scenario inputs, not authenticated documents. The points result is conditional on accepting the asserted training fact for benchmark arithmetic; real qualification documentation and authority assessment remain required.
